sources.title: GitHub - EnesDemir143/autolens-ai: 8-class vehicle body type classifier ...
sources.snippet: AutoLens AI is an 8-class vehicle body type classifier built with PyTorch, ONNX Runtime, Gradio, FastAPI, and React. The project compares CNN and Vision Transformer models on a custom-curated vehicle dataset and deploys the selected model through HuggingFace-compatible inference.
